question: Who among the following former Indian cricketers was appointed as the head coach of Uttarakhand Cricket Team in June 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Wasim Jaffer.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Wasim Jaffer**, an former Indian cricketer was appointed as the head coach of the **Uttarakhand Cricket Team in June 2020.**
 
• He is the only batsman to score 12,000 runs in Ranji Trophy and he also has the highest number of first-class hundreds to his name.
 
• Internationally, Jaffer played 31 Tests, scoring 1,944 runs.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__** 

__
 
• Uttarakhand: 

 
 
• Number of Districts - 13.
 
• National Parks - Jim Corbett National Park, Rajaji National Park, Valley Of Flowers National Park and Nanda Devi National Park.
 
• Registered GI - Uttarakhand Tejpat.
 
• Lok Sabha seats - 5.
 
• Rajya Sabha seats - 3.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Rahul Sharad Dravid**:

 
 
• He is a former cricket player who was appointed as the **head of National Cricket Academy (NCA) in 2019.**
 
• He was the former Indian team Captain and currently, he monitors the progress of India A and India U19.
 
• He has scored nearly 25,000 runs in international cricket and is widely considered to be one of the best batsmen in cricket history.
 
• He is also known as the Great wall of an Indian cricket team.
 
• He became the fifth Indian cricketer to be inducted into the ICC Hall of Fame in July 2018.
 
• He joined the **GoSports Foundation in 2014, in Bangalore**.
 
 
 
• **Sachin Tendulkar:**
 
 
• He is an Indian cricketer, he has hit his 100th international century whilst playing against Bangladesh in Asia Cup.
 
• In 2012 Tendulkar scored his 100th international century, with 10 fours and a six, at Dhaka.
 
• In February 2010, he became the first batsman to score a double hundred in one-day internationals, and also in December 2010.
 
• He became the first to score 50 Test tons both achieved against South Africa.
 
• He retired from all forms of cricket on 16 November 2013 after playing his 200th Test match, against the West Indies in Mumbai's Wankhede Stadium.
